title: Custom addresses
intro: A custom address swaps the default domain for something that carries your brand — for example, yourbrand.linkcharts.com.br/promo instead of the default link. You can create more than one and choose which to use when you shorten each link.

list.heading: Your addresses
list.empty: You haven't created a custom address yet.

releaseDialog.title: Release this address?
releaseDialog.body: Links created with this address will stop opening. You can claim the same name again later if it's still free.

claim.heading: Create a new address
claim.formatHint: 3–63 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens (not at the start or end).

validation.format: Use only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens (minimum 3 characters). Cannot start or end with a hyphen.

responsibility.text: By creating this address you confirm you are responsible for all content accessed through it and that you will not violate trademarks or third-party rights.
responsibility.checkbox: I have read and accept the terms above

errors.limitReached: You've reached your account's custom address limit.
errors.generic: Could not create the address. Please try again.

claim.limitReachedNotice: You've reached your account's custom address limit. Release an existing address to create another.
